rules: A review comment becomes BD only after checking current master.
Duplicate findings across PRs are one root BD item with recurrence_count > 1.
PR intent, NEXT and TODO text is not evidence that work was completed.
IMPLEMENTED requires current-code evidence; CONTROL requires runtime evidence.
SUPERSEDED requires an explicit replacement path, not silence.

open_bd.current_evidence: crew_rex_bridge.py builds observed_verbs from requested_action values

open_bd.title: Retain validated rejected task observations in canonical evidence history

open_bd.title: Counterbalance or randomize paired allocation task execution order
open_bd.current_evidence: run_frontier_tasks.py iterates manifest order sequentially; pair variant order remains confounded with warm-cache/order effects
open_bd.done_when: pair order is randomized/counterbalanced across repeated trials and order is recorded as an observed factor

open_bd.title: Fit Bradley-Terry abilities on the correct scale
open_bd.current_evidence: build_measured_allocation.py assigns each strategy full regularized log win/loss odds, centers them, then softmaxes, doubling two-node log-odds separation
open_bd.done_when: BT abilities are jointly fitted or two-node log odds are split consistently and regression-tested

open_bd.title: Derive/validate pair winner and relative gap from recorded timings

open_bd.done_when: winner and relative gap are derived from raw timings or exact consistency is asserted fail-closed
